_comment: Railway service config for @stimuliiq/api — Phase-7 Wave 4 (devops CI hardening), CLAUDE.md §1 'Railway for MVP'. Kept at the repo root so Railway auto-discovers it (Railway looks for railway.json/railway.toml at the project root by default). Build context is the repo root (monorepo-aware); see infra/docker/api.Dockerfile's own header comment for the multi-stage build rationale. Runtime env vars (SENTRY_DSN, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, METRICS_TOKEN, DATABASE_URL, etc. — see .env.example) are configured as persistent Railway SERVICE VARIABLES in the dashboard, not in this file (this file has no facility for secrets, by design). ECS Fargate (infra/ecs/task-definition.json) remains the documented scale-out target if/when Railway is outgrown.
